content.text: Blocked work ages quietly on boards. Managers want a dashboard signal when cards sit in a blocked state longer than a week without scanning every column.

New widget “Long-blocked issues” queries cards where blocked=true (or status category blocked) and blocked_since < now() - 7 days. List shows title, board, age in days, and blocker reason if present; click opens the card. Configurable threshold defaulting to 7 with options 3 / 7 / 14.
Ship when empty state explains “No cards blocked beyond threshold”, refresh matches other list widgets (5 min), and the widget respects board-level permissions of the viewer.
